profile_text.body:
Mem Labs is the company behind Mem, a product it describes as an AI-powered workspace for organizing team work, covering meeting notes, projects, and knowledge bases. The company positions Mem as making information instantly searchable and readily discoverable, with AI handling the organizational layer rather than leaving that work to users.

The site's held facts list Mem under the notes, knowledge, and meetings category, describing it as a personal knowledge base, accessible at get.mem.ai.
